notMachineCheckableObligations.obligation: Each acceptance criterion states a threshold the business would actually accept
notMachineCheckableObligations.detail: Every threshold is drawn from a stated measure in the supplied inputs: the owner count moving from two to six, a passing validation report with zero blocking failures, the three currently dispatching phases still dispatching, the two replay-reference fingerprints unchanged, and no verifier verdict regressing. A-007 states the reporting threshold the business intent itself sets, that a role meeting only the registration conditions is reported as partially rolled out.

notMachineCheckableObligations.obligation: The recorded scope matches what the requester asked for, with no silent widening
notMachineCheckableObligations.detail: All six in-scope items trace to the feature request's expected outcome list or to the business intent's success criteria. The four surfaces the change request marks conditional are admitted by D-004 with the requester's own blast-radius declaration as the basis, and the four stated non-goals are recorded as X-001 to X-004. Nothing unrequested was added; the one improvement the inputs invite but do not decide, the selection of which phase each role carries, is held as Q-002 rather than scoped.

notMachineCheckableObligations.obligation: The stated business goal is the goal the requester holds, not one inferred for them
notMachineCheckableObligations.detail: The Business goal restates the business intent's own Outcome sought sentence, that the framework can carry a change from scope through implementation, review, and quality without an operator standing in for a missing agent at each step. It is a restatement, not an inference.

escalationsRaised.decisionRequired: Confirm whether the five expected outcomes the feature request states per role are the five-part definition of done the business intent names as the acceptance boundary, and whether the first three are the registration conditions and the last two the execution conditions.
escalationsRaised.basis: The named definition of done lives outside both the supplied inputs and the frozen context slice, and this agent may not access it. The reading is recorded as D-005.
escalationsRaised.downstreamImpact: Every acceptance criterion is written against that reading. If it is wrong, the criteria change, and planning, design, and validation all inherit a different bar.

escalationsRaised.decisionRequired: Which phase each of the four roles carries to a completed and accepted output, given that only one of the twelve phases they own already declares a named output.
escalationsRaised.basis: A feasibility judgement this artifact has no supplied basis to make; deciding it here would be choosing the technical route under the appearance of choosing scope.
escalationsRaised.downstreamImpact: Solution design selects the phase per role; the boundary states only that each role reaches the bar.

escalationsRaised.decisionRequired: Which reading is current, the supplied architecture context that records the feature workflow's scope and implementation phases as prose-output phases, or the workflow specification in this run's frozen context slice that names an output for both.
